message: I’ve got this friend who panics at the mere mention of fire safety—like, if I say ‘smoke alarm,’ he’s already mapping out our escape route. It’s a little over the top, but he does remind me how important it is to have a plan. We all chuckle, but I’ve started keeping my own fire safety checklist handy. It’s funny how a little prep can turn a ‘what-if’ into a ‘no big deal.’ Do you have a safety plan in place?
